name: FEL MCP Server (Local)
description: Enables validation and PDF rendering of Guatemalan FEL invoices from XML files. Supports single file processing and batch operations with branded PDF output for local tax compliance workflows.

rawRecord.description: Enables validation and PDF rendering of Guatemalan FEL invoices from XML files. Supports single file processing and batch operations with branded PDF output for local tax compliance workflows.

FEL_THEME.description: Theme setting for the PDF rendering

FEL_QR_SIZE.description: QR code size for PDF rendering

FEL_XML_PATH.description: Absolute WSL path to the XML file

FEL_LOGO_PATH.description: Optional absolute WSL path to the logo image file

FEL_OUTPUT_PDF.description: Absolute WSL path for the output PDF file

FEL_BATCH_OUT_DIR.description: Absolute WSL path to the batch output directory

FEL_TOP_BAR_HEIGHT.description: Top bar height for PDF layout

FEL_FONT_DIR_MONTSERRAT.description: Absolute WSL path to Montserrat font directory

FEL_FONT_DIR_ROBOTOMONO.description: Absolute WSL path to Roboto Mono font directory
